locators: Methods: study design, endpoints and assessments
Results: histology-specific five-year PFS and OS
primary_sources.finding: The randomized cohort was predominantly systemic ALCL. Overall outcomes cannot be presented as PTCL-NOS or AITL subgroup outcomes. Exploratory five-year subgroup estimates have wide confidence intervals; they do not establish absence of benefit or justify universal subtype-specific superiority. The comparator was CHOP, not CHOEP.

locators: Recommendations: PTCL-NOS and TFHL; systemic ALCL
primary_sources.finding: The guideline distinguishes PTCL-NOS/TFHL recommendations from systemic ALCL and reports restricted European approval. Its limited-subgroup discussion is not proof of no benefit for an individual. Current EMA authorization and Ukrainian registration, access and reimbursement require their own verification.

The US indication includes previously untreated adult CD30-expressing PTCL-NOS and AITL with CHP. Trial enrollment required CD30 expression at least 10%; that entry criterion must not be rewritten as a universal label cutoff. Label authorization is distinct from a histology-specific comparative efficacy claim.

findings.problem: CD30 positivity alone selects BV-CHP in ordinary PTCL-NOS and AITL first-line algorithms without a jurisdiction or explicitly reviewed decision context.

Shared indication claims a universal standard across ALCL/PTCL-NOS/AITL. AITL indication labels its subset favorable and asserts substantial historical improvement without a traceable valid comparison; pooled estimates are misrepresented.
B-cell NCCN source is used for T-cell selection and category-1/strong claims. These claims were not substantiated by the sources reviewed here; current T-cell NCCN was not retrieved.
The records conflate ECHELON-2 CD30 enrollment cutoff with universal treatment eligibility.

Both BV indications inherit a bortezomib-specific contraindication and claim baseline grade-2 neuropathy is an absolute contraindication. These are identified for a dedicated label/safety review, not validated or repaired by this audit.

The current CD30-negative PTCL-NOS/AITL synthetic examples still expose a BV-CHP alternative. This observation does not prove confirmed expression or eligibility; required biomarker validation must be traced before the candidate is presented as usable.

implementation_this_turn: Source audit and six current synthetic route observations only. No clinical algorithm, dose, indication, source record, patient page, translation or runtime bundle changed.
required_follow_up: Separate histology-specific outcome and preference claims, including EN/UA text and downstream translated publications.
Verify current regional authorization with official sources; never infer jurisdiction from interface language.
Choose an explicit reviewed selection/uncertainty contract before changing default routing; preserve ALCL evidence and do not automatically substitute CHOEP.
Audit contraindication provenance and test/biomarker identifiers separately.
Verify selected, alternatives, clinician/patient rendering, cached/offline bundles and API copies when the correction is implemented.
limitations: Six synthetic existing cases are not a complete eligibility or treatment-choice audit.
No real patient data, model-provider calls or clinical/language signoff.
No production publication in this audit-only delivery.
